card.desc: Refusal. The form is wrong, the door will not open.
card.prompt: a short low digital error buzz, flat descending two-tone, dry, synthetic
card.negative: music, melody, speech, reverb, siren, alarm bell, long
card.note: Descending is what makes it read as negative; a rising buzz sounds like a prompt.
